title: ad-creative
purpose: Generate high-performing ad copy at scale with platform-specific specs, angle-based organization, character-count validation, AI+Remotion visual workflows, and performance-driven iteration.
when: When generating or iterating paid ad copy at scale, producing headlines and descriptions with character counts, organizing copy by angles, or iterating based on performance data.

title: content-creator
purpose: Create brand-consistent content with voice analysis, SEO-optimized blog posts, platform-specific social media content, and content calendar planning.
when: When writing blog posts, creating social media content, establishing brand voice, optimizing content for SEO, or planning content calendars.

title: pdf-processing
purpose: Process PDF documents programmatically using Python (pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab) and CLI tools (qpdf, pdftk) for merging, splitting, extraction, form filling, OCR, and creation.
when: When merging, splitting, extracting text or tables from, creating, filling forms in, adding watermarks to, or OCR-scanning PDF documents.

title: vector-workflow-automation
purpose: Automate and normalize vector design workflows including SVG cleanup, icon-set normalization, token-aware production, batch exports, and engineering-ready handoff.
when: When preparing icon sets or other vector assets for consistent multi-platform use, especially when source quality, naming, and export consistency vary.

title: raster-retouch-pipeline
purpose: Run non-destructive raster retouch workflows for cleanup, correction, multi-channel resizing, metadata-aware QA, and controlled export variants.
when: When cleaning, correcting, resizing, and exporting product or campaign imagery while preserving source fidelity and traceable editing history.

title: creative-asset-handoff
purpose: Package and deliver creative assets with strict source/export separation, naming/versioning conventions, provenance notes, and acceptance criteria.
when: When delivering finalized assets to engineering, marketing, clients, or operations teams that require predictable folders, manifests, and approval status.
